agenda.2026-11-23-belgique-manifestation: Belgium: unions hold a national demonstration in Brussels

The ACV-CSC, FGTB-ABVV and SYNOVA unions expect thousands of people to protest against cuts to the De Wever government's social budget, with disruption expected in Brussels [1][2]. The size of the turnout will weigh on a government already weakened by its budget [3].
agenda.2026-11-28-france-senat-partie-re: France: the Senate finishes reviewing the revenue side of the 2027 budget

After deputies rejected the bill on November 4, senators are debating the taxes in the 2027 budget from November 20 to November 28 or 29 [1][2]. Their choices (the 10% allowance for retirees, taxation of broadcasting…) will form the basis of the compromise the government is seeking around a deficit of 5% of GDP [2].
